why_ai: Statutory fiduciary boards and slow-feedback investment commitments protect the core, while benefit processing on screens is exposed.
why_clarity: Benefit calculations are exact and recur by the thousand, but investment decisions and record errors are graded years later.
why_digital: Records, documents and portfolios are digital; members and employers are served by statewide systems through procurement and regional offices.

why_ai: Irreversible ten-year commitments made on officers' reads of GP teams, approved by fiduciary boards and judged by relationships.
why_clarity: Each re-up is a one-off judgement and fund outcomes are known a decade later.
why_digital: GP documents and cash flows are digital, but the read comes from annual meetings and in-person relationships.

why_ai: Reconciling GP statements and recomputing fees from LPA terms is document work AI extraction does well.
why_clarity: Every fee and cash flow either reconciles to the terms and custodian or does not, every quarter for hundreds of funds.
why_digital: Documents in, reconciled records and reports out, bought as remote software and services.

why_ai: Setting a commitment budget under market stress involves board risk appetite and judgement the forecast informs but does not replace.
why_clarity: Forecasts are checkable against realised quarterly cash flows, though methods differ and stress events are rare.
why_digital: Cash-flow histories and scenarios in, forecasts and board reports out, on screens.

why_ai: Multi-year system replacements depend on trusted vendors and staff judgement at cutover, while rule extraction and testing automate.
why_clarity: Every converted benefit can be checked against the old system, but each project is a once-in-decades event.
why_digital: Data and code in, configured systems out, bought through public procurement with on-site implementation teams.

why_ai: Checking payroll files against pensionability rules is rule execution and anomaly detection that software can do.
why_clarity: Pay codes and tiers either comply or not, every pay period for thousands of employers, though errors surface years later.
why_digital: Payroll files in, validated records and correction requests out, all online.

why_ai: Posting remittances and crediting hours is routine work, held in place by trustee relationships and union-employer governance.
why_clarity: Hours either post to the right member or not, monthly for every employer, though gaps show up at retirement.
why_digital: Small contractors still send paper and spreadsheets, and fund offices serve local trades through trustees.

why_ai: Volunteer fiduciary boards and long relationships with local actuaries and consultants run these plans, and the filings automate.
why_clarity: Obligations recur on fixed calendars, but plan decisions are tested only over decades.
why_digital: Member records sit in town payroll and spreadsheets, and boards meet in person under open-meeting laws.

why_ai: Sponsors are exiting these plans, so demand for running them shrinks, though fiduciary transaction decisions stay human.
why_clarity: Data readiness and premium are measurable per transaction, but each sponsor does it once.
why_digital: Census and plan data on screens, with transactions run through consultants and insurer bids.

why_ai: Benefit formulas applied to member records are exactly what calculation engines and AI assistants do.
why_clarity: Codified formulas, thousands of near-identical cases, and a final number that either matches or needs recalculating.
why_digital: Member records in, estimates, letters and payments out, with counseling by phone and online.

why_ai: Death matching and change-request risk scoring are high-volume pattern work machines do better than clerks.
why_clarity: Each payment is either proper or not before a fixed monthly cutoff, at volume.
why_digital: Payroll, death and bank data in, holds and alerts out, entirely digital.

why_ai: Credentialed actuaries must sign zone certifications and valuations and hold long trustee relationships.
why_clarity: Actuarial standards codify methods, but projection accuracy is known only over years.
why_digital: Plan data valued on screens, presented to joint boards of trustees in meetings.

why_ai: Reading public board minutes and extracting searches and commitments is exactly what language models do.
why_clarity: Thousands of near-identical extractions from public documents, checkable against the source.
why_digital: Public documents in, online databases and alerts out, sold remotely.

why_ai: Decades of participant-submitted cost and service data is an asset AI cannot synthesise, though the computation automates.
why_clarity: Standard survey definitions applied to the same funds every year produce checkable comparisons.
why_digital: Survey data in, benchmarking reports out, presented to boards remotely or in person.

why_ai: Boards pay trusted consultants for fiduciary advice presented in person, while the performance computation automates.
why_clarity: Quarterly reports follow a standard method, but whether allocation advice was right shows over years.
why_digital: Custodial data processed on screens, delivered at in-person board meetings.

why_ai: Pooled member-level mortality data across plans is a moat AI cannot reproduce.
why_clarity: Mortality models follow actuarial methods, but their accuracy shows only over many years of deaths.
why_digital: Member data in, mortality curves and reports out, delivered digitally.

why_ai: Collecting, extracting and reconciling GP documents for each LP is service work AI is automating directly.
why_clarity: Each reconciliation either ties to the custodian and the terms or not, across thousands of near-identical statements.
why_digital: Documents in, reconciled reports out, delivered remotely as a managed service.

why_ai: Licensed lawyers run adversarial litigation for institutional clients who pick the firm they trust.
why_clarity: Loss calculations are standard, but case merit and outcome take years.
why_digital: Trade data analysed on screens; cases are run in court and clients won through relationships.

why_ai: Long-horizon return forecasts are judgement under deep uncertainty, but AI and asset managers publish credible alternatives.
why_clarity: Methods differ by firm and forecasts resolve only after a decade.
why_digital: Market data in, published assumptions out, digitally.

why_ai: Pricing actuaries sign assumptions for insurers whose demand grows as sponsors exit.
why_clarity: Pricing follows actuarial methods on every census, but mortality outcomes take years.
why_digital: Census data in, bids out, through consultant-run transactions.

why_ai: Percentile rankings on contributed returns are a computation any data platform can run.
why_clarity: Exact quarterly computations with agreed definitions.
why_digital: Return data in, universes out, entirely digital.

why_ai: Statutory authority to insure, review and enforce cannot be handed to software, though no buyer chooses the agency for a relationship.
why_clarity: Reviews follow statutory methods, though projections resolve over years.
why_digital: Filings and actuarial data in, determinations and statistics out, electronically.

why_ai: Fiduciary investment boards making high-stakes allocation and manager decisions for many plans.
why_clarity: Returns are measurable against benchmarks, but decisions are judgement-led and slow to grade.
why_digital: Portfolio data on screens, with managers and participating plans met in person.

why_ai: A named fiduciary must make and defend the insurer choice, with litigation risk attached.
why_clarity: A documented method is applied per deal, but insurer failure is rare and slow to test.
why_digital: Statutory filings and ratings analysed on screens, delivered as reports.

why_ai: Statutory oversight bodies whose authority, not their analysis, gives the work its weight.
why_clarity: Reviews follow statute, but funding soundness plays out over decades.
why_digital: Plan filings in, reports and actuarial notes out, for one state's plans.

why_ai: Policy research on public data that AI can increasingly produce, with credibility tied to the organisation.
why_clarity: Research questions vary and policy effects take years to show.
why_digital: Public data in, reports out, distributed online.

why_ai: Configuring rules and converting data is software work increasingly done by tools.
why_clarity: Configurations are testable against expected benefits, though each client differs.
why_digital: Code and data in, systems out, sold through public procurement.

why_ai: Locating people from licensed records is automated matching.
why_clarity: Each search finds a confirmed address or death or it does not, at volume.
why_digital: Records in, located addresses out, entirely remote.
